result.stateSummary: This source is a slice (§379–§493, 2026-08-22 to 2026-08-23) of a chair-kept program ledger — a chronological run of collection, ruling and landing rows for a 45-landing cascade across the map/port, website, producer, undercity, housekeeping and research trains. It records deferral in a strikingly disciplined way: rulings are stamped in place ('RULED', 'RATIFIED', 'CHARTERED', 'SIGNED'), deferrals are named and dated ('QUEUED (deferred, not dropped)', 'DEFERRED-DOCUMENTED', 'docketed to the owner', 'ARCHITECTED-NOT-BUILT'), and owner items accumulate on an explicit OWNER DOCKET with a chair recommendation attached to each. Two owner grants (§464, and the seat/model directives §447/§481/§484) moved most judgment to the chair, leaving a narrow set of items owner-gated by nature: the db push (195–199, with 198 destructive), the Stripe acts, the /code-review ultra keystroke, the tuning signature, legal sign-off, and the cull. Roughly fifty items remain open here: five chartered-but-unbuilt trains (catalog-hygiene, the W-C/W-D website cars, the content train, the DW program, the endgame), about a dozen instrument and housekeeping debts (HK-4, HK-5, HK-6, the declared-movement class, the pulse-time-writer exemption, the comparator divergence row, the prngSeedEntropy tolerance, the worker-cap experiment), and a research layer whose dossiers were accepted only on the condition of a P1c re-verification that has not run. A further standing debt is the OPUS REGISTER: every row from §484 onward is stamped '[OPUS-RUN · FABLE-VALIDATION OWED]', so the validation backlog is still growing at the source's last section.

result.stateSummary: THE OWNER DECISION QUEUE is the estate's single consolidated surface for owner decisions, opened 2026-07-26 by owner order and grown by append into 125 numbered sections spanning 2026-07-26 to 2026-08-15. Resolutions are recorded in place as "✅ RULED <date>: …" and never deleted, so a section without such a line — or one whose ruling only schedules the act ("waits on", "parked", "docketed", "owed", "stays open") — is still open. Its character changes across the file: §§0–9 are a compact decision register (T/D/G/P/M/EP rows), while §§10–125 become a running chair ledger of train rulings in which most "rulings" are dispositions that mint new deferrals — micro-acts, dockets, re-charters and compile obligations — faster than they discharge them. Four superseding owner grants (§17, §22, §24, §37) release nearly every permission-class blocker, but four carve-outs survive by nature and still gate the tail: external legal/counsel, the V5 aesthetic cull, THE TUNING SIGNATURE, and each push/deploy; §53.1's P1 records that even the grants' reach over the signature and pushes is itself an unanswered owner question. Of the ~78 items enumerated here, roughly a dozen are strictly owner acts (the launch tail T1–T15, the §13 worktree, the §67.6 cull, §66.4 import-vs-restore, the M44 dial list, the two tm value flags), about twenty are chartered-but-unbuilt programs (the whole LG logistics family, tm, AO/H26, gen-2, the ~96 remaining family waves, the §109 total review), and the rest are docketed engineering debts and micro-acts queued behind an executor order that the record ends mid-flight. Several rows are genuinely ambiguous — T1 is marked EXECUTED at §0 yet re-asserted as blocking at §71.5/§109.4, and P6 is owner-parked at §56/§71.2 yet decided under delegation at §114 — and are flagged for the synthesizer rather than dropped.

This source is a slice (part 2 of 11) of docs/OWNER_DECISION_QUEUE.md — the estate's running chair ledger, numbered §125 through §270 and dated 2026-08-15 to 2026-08-17. It is not a to-do list: it is a chronological record of owner directives, chair rulings (each marked "vetoable"), lane collections and their receipts, so a ruling appears IN PLACE as a "RULED / RATIFIED / SIGNED / ACCEPTED" sentence inside the section that records it, and a deferral appears as "queued", "owed", "parked", "carried, named", "deferred with cause", "OWNER-GATED", "OWNER-VALUE", or "raised, not settled". The file's overwhelming subject is the map-fabric (mf) program, which ran from a charter (§150) through nine build waves, three prior-art studies, a 313-plate reference corpus and a 24-stage generation specification with a 42-row gap ledger and a nine-wave plan (W0–W8) of which only W0 and W1 had been dispatched when the slice ends mid-sentence at §270. Alongside it run four other undischarged threads: the engine family-train queue (cn/pg/WF/WC/LG/WY/POP and the §27 tail), the soak program (rolling soaks RS-1..RS-3, the diagnostic soak still unfired), the launch/legal cluster (§133/§133a), and a standing 18-item owner decision batch plus a nineteenth item that §264.4 re-confirms as still the owner's. Roughly a quarter of the rows below are owner-gated by the record's own words; most of the rest are chair-chartered work with a named slot (wave nine, W2–W8, "next worktree slot") but no completion recorded anywhere in this slice — and because the slice is truncated at §270, a handful of rows may have been discharged in later parts and are marked unclear where this source itself hints at it.

It records rulings in place with explicit verbs ("RULED", "RATIFIED", "SIGNED", "DISCHARGED", "SEALED at refs/preserve/…"), and it records deferrals just as explicitly, with a house vocabulary: "OWED, AND NOW NAMED", "CHARTERED", "QUEUED, not amended", "DEFERRED AND DOCUMENTED (recorded so they are not re-found as bugs)", "HELD", "THIN", and "the owner's call, not the chair's". Its dominant arc is the map REGISTER programme — begun when the owner re-aimed the estate at the corpus's visual register — which after six waves of owner catches converted into a full SPINE re-founding of the map builder on a partition-first model, released by the owner's one-word "Go" at §669. Alongside that arc it carries the catalog-hygiene residue, the unbuilt DW (42 cars) and AD (17 cars) programmes, the website/parity/small tails, and the endgame (walk + one regen → soaks → tuning signature). Two governance threads run through it: a standing by-nature carve-out list (every push and deploy, the cutover, the tuning signature, legal, the cull, /code-review ultra, the film specimen) that survives every delegation grant, and — from §685 onward, at the owner's fourth issuing of the same order — a re-armed Fable retrovalidation register whose true owed surface is 130 ledger sections whose provenance is UNKNOWN. result.stateSummary: This source is a contiguous slice (§762.1 through §874.3, dated 2026-08-30 to 2026-09-01) of the SettlementForge OWNER DECISION QUEUE — a chair-written, append-only ledger where each numbered § records an owner directive, a chair ruling made under a standing delegation grant, or a train/lane collection and landing. Deferral is recorded in place and in the ledger's own vocabulary: items are "chartered", "docketed", "deferred priced", "priced-not-landed", "owed", "carried", "to the OWNER batch", "flagged to the owner", "vetoable", or "on the morning desk"; a ruling is marked in place (e.g. "RULED", "RATIFIED", "DISCHARGED", "CAS EXECUTED") and a later § routinely reports an item landed, so many rows opened early in the slice are visibly closed later in it. The slice's overall state is a programme running at full saturation toward launch: roughly a dozen trains land to the branch (STRIP-FINISH, HERALD, RESIDUE, W-COIN, EFF-1, T5 Genesis, T10, T2, T7, T6, T9, T11, SEAT-A, T12, DENSITY, the smalls, the character substrate), while at the end of the slice at least a dozen more are built-and-holding but never CASed, and the entire character/faith/ops program ships dark with no flag, no preset and no production caller. result.stateSummary: This source is the last slice (part 11 of 11) of docs/OWNER_DECISION_QUEUE.md — the estate's single owner-facing ledger — covering §912 through §919 (2026-09-07 to 2026-09-09), the stretch in which the prose reconciliation was ratified, the whole rewrite was commissioned, and six consists landed (L-MAT §913, the instruments §914, the measure train §915, the seam train §916, the light train §917, the taste and sitting §918, the rewrite's first car §919). Its recording convention is dense but consistent: an owner directive is quoted verbatim and stamped "✅ RULED <date>" or "✅ CHAIR RULING <date> (vetoable)"; each landing section then carries fixed sub-headings — "Refusals kept as results", "Deferred, documented, not bugs to re-find", "Rulings (vetoable)", "OWNER ROWS" and "Next:" — so deferral is explicit and auditable rather than implied. Almost everything in this slice is process and instrumentation: five of the six consists moved ZERO reader-facing bytes, and the one that lit a dial (§917) added two keys at birth and wrote no migration. The long tail it leaves is therefore three-layered: a small set of hard owner decisions (the three numbers Q4/Q5/Q15, the schema acts (a)–(k), the `_gallery_dm_full_json` SQL twin, the persisted-receipt marker, the wave's staffing and funding, the seven lost raw exemplar registers, and the standing reservation of the push and the walk); a very large body of chartered-but-unbuilt corpus work (the rewrite wave from 8b onward at roughly ten thousand variants, the authoring wave, the surface-text program, 591 source-unresolved census rows, 448 variants in unmounted blocks, 114 unreachable variants, 128 bare future indicatives); and a long ledger of instrument debts and refusals kept as results. Of the ~75 rows extracted, about half are explicitly deferred with a named future home (8b, the authoring wave, the CAPACITY train, the parity train, a sitting), roughly fifteen are owner-gated with no ruling recorded, and six are marked unclear because a later section in this same source appears to have discharged them (the DM panel's gazetteer source, DS-DEF-2's wiring, the co-occurrence floor, `granary`, the sibling distance measure, the passage-shape ruling) — those need reconciliation against the other parts.

result.stateSummary: This source is part 6 of the ledger inside docs/OWNER_DECISION_QUEUE.md, covering §692 through §748 — the town-map spine/dress/port programme collected wave by wave (§692–§723), then the descope sitting and everything after it (§724–§748). Rulings are recorded in place in the section that makes them, as "RULED", "CHARTERED", "DOCKET ROW STRUCK", "→ OWNER DOCKET" or an explicit owner quote with its verbatim intent; deferrals are almost always named with their rationale ("deferred with rationale", "reported and not cured", "blocked, not run — and named as such"), which makes the open surface unusually legible but very large. The dominant structural fact is the owner's descope (§724, §725, §738, §739, §740): the entire settlement-layer mapmaking programme — including the framing trade, the enclosure operator, the ~3.4× capacity over-statement, the DW dwellings programme, the AD programme, C-19, CT-1b, COVER-REFRESH and the whole undercity train — moves to a post-launch GPL-3.0 module, while the legacy in-product map is stripped entirely. What remains on the launch path is itself substantial and mostly unstarted: STRIP waves 2/4/5/6, the ~21-car FMG WEAVE programme, W-COIN and W-SEAT (both architected and panel-attacked but blocked on owner rows), the MF/WEB/HK/WF-8/catalog residue, one OSR mint, parity, the walk, one regeneration, the terminal soak, the tuning signature and the push. Roughly twenty owner questions stand unanswered at the source's end (Q-W1..Q-W7, Q-W9, Q10, Q11, Q-S2..Q-S8 plus a widened Q4), alongside an older nine-item docket, and a substantial historical debt (130 UNKNOWN-provenance sections, 147 unruled retrovalidation rows, three P0s) that the descope deliberately leaves with launch. The record also carries a long tail of small, well-documented engineering debts — unit-less numeric fields read differently by every consumer, censuses whose predicate is weaker than their name, instruments lagging their own code, and the growth ledger's untested fold — none of which has a car recorded against it.

result.stateSummary: This source is a contiguous slice of the estate's append-only owner/chair ledger (docs/OWNER_DECISION_QUEUE.md), covering §883.3 through §911.1 from 2026-09-02 to 2026-09-07 — roughly twenty landings, each a numbered entry with its own date stamp and seat line (Seat: Opus 5 — Fable-unvalidated, or Fable 5.1 — validated). Deferral is recorded three distinct ways: as explicit "owner rows opened" blocks routed to the owner and never absorbed, as chair rulings marked vetoable with their ground and their veto shape, and as named deferrals-with-a-home ("recorded as a deferral with a home, not a dropped thread"), plus standing lists — the §892.1 fourteen-item LIVE-FAULT LIST and the §910 D1–D5 receipt ledger. Rulings appear in place, usually as "RULED (Fable 5.1)" or "✅ RULED 2026-09-07", and withdrawals as "⛔ SUPERSEDED at §N"; an item with none of these is still open. The dominant open structure at the end of the span is a sequencing chain the owner controls: the reconciliation (S12) must pass, then the taste sample, then the owner's WALK, then the terminal soak, then tuning LAST — and every push and deploy stays the owner's throughout. About a dozen items are pure owner decisions with no ruling anywhere (the watermark, the founder-name producer, DS-GEN-1, the drift door, the espionage sentences, the dossier-pdf over-declarations), roughly fifteen more are ruled-but-unexecuted or awaiting a condition (SOAK-1, CAP-10, CAP-11, the successor presets, rungs 19 and 20, L-MAT), and a long tail of instrument and process debt (the tuning register scoring a naming act as debt, chair-commit.sh's missing prefix gate, the stale heartbeat template, the ratchet's budget misreport) is carried forward without cure. Four prominent rows that were deferred early in this span are shown DONE later in the same source and are marked "unclear" for the synthesizer to reconcile.

result.stateSummary: This source is part 2 of 3 of docs/FABLE_VALIDATION_QUEUE.md (4,175 lines, covering roughly 2026-08-03 through 2026-08-09): the append-only ledger in which Opus-seat lanes bank every chair-grade judgment they made without a Fable chair, each row explicitly stamped VETOABLE and most closing with a "WHAT FABLE SHOULD RE-EXAMINE (protocol step 2)" column. Rows are never rewritten — a correction rides beside the row it corrects (the WZ-5r / WR-10r precedent) — so supersessions, errata, retractions and re-measurements accumulate rather than replace, and several items are closed several rows after they are opened. Deferral is recorded in a small set of stock idioms that make the long tail enumerable: "DELIBERATELY DEFERRED — DOCUMENTED, NOT A BUG TO RE-FIND", "⛔ PARKED — OWNER-GATED", "OWNER-HELD", "OWED", and "STOP-AND-REPORT (report, don't rule — §10.6)". On validation the queue is essentially unpaid: the newest sections carry a "✅ OPUS-ERA — FABLE-SURVEYED 2026-08-09 (F-S1)" stamp recording that a survey pass happened, but not one individual J-* or CR-* judgment anywhere in the file is marked ruled, vetoed or affirmed by Fable — so all ~46 enumerated cycle-4 judgments plus roughly eighty earlier ones remain awaiting validation, with survey priorities written but unanswered. The largest single item is structural rather than a defect: the cycle-4 close re-derives the remaining-work table as 113 declared waves with 11 whole landed and 2 part-built, i.e. 102 remaining, and 42 of FP §3's 52 flag rows still unminted. The estate does not exit this part green — tests/lint, npm run lint and the full typecheck are red at HEAD from pre-existing debt so npm run check cannot finish — and the acceptance verdict, the soak redo, and every tuning band remain owner-held despite the 2026-08-05 blanket sign-off, which four carve-outs (legal, aesthetic cull, tuning signature, pushes) explicitly survive.

result.stateSummary: This source is the second half of docs/FABLE_RETROVALIDATION_QUEUE.md — an append-only enrolment ledger in which every chair act, lane car and judgment call of the SettlementForge build programme is written up as a numbered stratum (§883.5 through §919) so that a later Fable-seat sitting can re-derive it from primary receipts. Each stratum records what was judged, what a returning seat must re-derive, its receipts and a priority; validated strata then carry an appended `*RULED (§892, Fable 5.1):*` paragraph with a RATIFIED / AMENDED / REVERSED / EVIDENCE-THIN verdict, and unvalidated ones carry either `SEAT: Opus 5 — Fable-unvalidated` or a closing `Status:` line. The state is heavily unfinished on the validation axis: the §892 sitting ruled 43 strata and a later pass (§896.1) ruled 28 more, but it closed PARTIAL — the completeness critic S99 never ran, eight EVIDENCE-THIN calls stay PLAUSIBLE, and the historical strata §685 and §687–§723 are still queued behind an owner trigger. Of the 82 numbered retrovalidation rows in the later sections, roughly 65 (R1–R65, covering §893 through §902) are explicitly unvalidated — R1–R36 stamped ⟦OPUS-AUTHORED — Fable retrovalidation OWED⟧ and R37–R65 each closing with "enrolled, not ruled" — while R66–R82 (§903–§919) were partly ruled at their own landings and carry named residues instead. Beneath that validation backlog the strata name a large body of concrete deferred work: a blocking public-dossier prose gate, an unrebased 200-path prose car waiting on an owner-named window, an eleven-word corpus hole that has become a shipping defect, seven unlanded golden-freeze cars, a census jammed at 10/10 that is the arc's binding scheduling constraint, several uninstalled guards in the chair's own tooling, and a standing owner's desk of eight items plus three permanently owner-only classes (the walk, the tuning signature, every push).

docs/FABLE_RETROVALIDATION_QUEUE.md (part 1 of 2, 2,250 lines) is the ledger-branch register of every judgment an Opus seat made that a Fable seat still owes a second look, created at §236, re-armed by owner order at §685 (2026-08-26) and appended to continuously through §883.5 (2026-09-02). It records deferral by ROW: each row states what was judged, what Fable re-derives, where the receipts are, and a priority (P0 poisoned discharges · P1 taste/closure · P2 foreclosing architecture · P3 minted constants · P4 mechanical); a row is discharged ONLY by an appended "*RULED (§N, Fable 5.1)*" line carrying RATIFIED / AMENDED / REVERSED / EVIDENCE-THIN. Part 1 carries roughly 90 rows. Thirty-seven of them — the whole 2026-08-26 historical block §685–§723 — carry no ruling line at all, and the file states three separate times (§879 preamble, §881.19, §882.14.3) that "the historical strata (§685's dark window, §687–§723) stay QUEUED at the owner's trigger — this file does NOT report itself empty." A further twelve rows (§880.1–§880.5, §882.8.1, §882.9, §882.12, §883.7, §883.5(a)(b)(c)) are appended with no ruling. Two pre-authored tables — §6.1's eleven historical-era strata and §6.2's thirteen forward-arc waves — have never been walked at all. The rows ruled at §879/§881/§882/§892 are mostly RATIFIED, but many carry an explicit "Not re-derived:" residue and many more route concrete repair, instrument and owner-decision work forward as dockets, hygiene cars, handovers and held owner rows; those are extracted below alongside the unruled rows. The pass is owner-triggered and a scoped pass empties only what it covers.

result.stateSummary: This source is part 3 of docs/FABLE_VALIDATION_QUEUE.md — the estate's governance ledger, where each wave, repair round and chair batch files a row containing its stop-reports, its vetoable judgments, its deliberate deferrals and its executed gate receipts. result.stateSummary: This source is the second half of docs/A_PLUS_ROADMAP.md: a grade-by-area engineering roadmap covering data-schema (tail), State Layer, React UI feature surface, PDF parity, GENERATORS, LIB/SERVICES, Testing + Tooling, Domain Engine and Backend. Each area opens with an A+ bar, a highest-leverage paragraph and a dependency-driven sequencing note, then enumerates numbered steps (e.g. state.1, generators.4) each carrying a severity/effort/risk stamp and a Change / Why / Done-when triple. Completion is recorded in two ways — a ✅ DONE marker appended to a step heading, or a ✅/◐ blockquote inserted above or below a step that narrates what actually shipped, sometimes with a commit sha; that second form is where the honest residuals live, because several steps are marked done while their blockquote names a remainder. Of the eight areas in this part, two are reported finished (LIB/SERVICES as a whole, Track E; PDF steps 1, 2, 3, 5, 6 and 7-as-self-guard), one is partly finished (React UI: the size ratchet and steps .3-.7 landed, .2 and .8 did not), and five are wholly open: State Layer (5 steps), GENERATORS (8), Testing + Tooling (4 of 6), Domain Engine (7) and Backend (6). I extracted 41 open items. Only one carries an explicit owner gate in the record's own words (generators.6's frozen 'mill' false-match, resolvable 'ONLY if the owner signs off'); tests-tooling.1 changes deploy posture through GitHub repo settings and is an owner/repo-admin act in practice though the record does not say so. Three rows are flagged for the synthesizer to reconcile: pdf.4 (heading marked DONE but its own progress note names defense-readiness and topExport as remaining), pdf.7 (marked DONE as a self-guard while its standalone heading specifies a different, unbuilt fieldManifest row), and LIB/SERVICES (declared complete, with lib.6's Plausible-queue sub-clause the one acceptance detail the completion note does not restate).
